summary: Captains are combat-capable officers who provide leadership, tactical coordination, and access to Command Abilities.

units.name: Captain
units.description: Captains are experienced combatants and military leaders who provide tactical Commands to nearby troops. The standard Captain is an Elite Unit that occupies an E Recruitment Slot and does not count toward the Hero maximum. A Captain receives two eligible generic Captain Commands without additional cost; the Heroic Commission upgrade below makes it a Hero and lets it occupy an H Recruitment Slot.

options.name: Great Weapon
options.notes: Fewer but more damaging Attacks, with extra dice against Armored foes.

equipmentAndCombatTraining.note: A Captain may purchase up to two Combat Training upgrades, excluding weapon equipment and shields. Choose one melee weapon and up to one optional ranged weapon. The Armored upgrade is Combat Training; a Shield is equipment. Deadly Precision unlocks a personal CP Command.

options.name: Standard Equipment
options.effect: Retain the Captain's chosen melee weapon and standard defenses.

options.name: Shield
options.effect: Improve Armor from 5+ to 4+. May be used with Officer's Weapon, Spear, and an optional Pistol, but not with Great Weapon, Dual Weapons, Bow, Crossbow, or Musket.

options.name: Defensive
options.effect: Gain Brace 1, reducing incoming Charge Impact by 1.

options.name: Battle-Hardened
options.effect: Gain Tough 1, rerolling up to one natural 1 on Armor Saves.

options.name: Deadly Precision
options.effect: When this Unit declares a Weapon Attack during its own Assault or Combat activation, spend 1 CP. For each Surge generated by that Attack roll, convert up to one failed Hit die into a Critical Hit (Critical 1 per Surge); Ward still applies. This works with any eligible weapon. The Unit may use the Command on another eligible Attack for another 1 CP, never twice on the same Attack. This grants no extra Attack or activation.

options.name: Master Hunter
options.effect: This unit gains Anti-[Type] 2.

options.name: Armored
options.effect: Improve the Captain's Armor one step and gain the Armored tag.

options.name: Survivor
options.effect: Increase Wounds from 4 to 5.

options.name: Weapon Master
options.effect: The selected weapon gains Accurate 1 and improves its Hit characteristic by one step.

options.name: Mounted
options.effect: Increase Move to M6", gain +1 Wound and Charge 3. Loses Infantry tag and gains Cavalry.

options.name: Veterans
options.effect: Every weapon the Captain carries gains +1 Attack and improves its Hit characteristic by one step.

options.name: Heroic Commission
options.effect: Gain Hero and H eligibility while retaining Elite; increase Wounds by 1; every weapon the Captain currently carries gains +1 Attack. The Captain now counts toward the three-Hero limit. This grants Hero, NOT Unique. A named legacy Captain may separately gain Unique by an explicit conversion.

commands.note: Choose two Command Abilities at no additional cost. All listed Command Abilities cost 1 CP. In 2,000-point matched play, expend CP using the selected cards as described in the Matched-Play Command Points and Cards rules; campaign encounters may use abstract CP without any cards.

options.name: Press the Attack
options.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within Short. Its next Melee Attack this Round gains Critical 1 from this CP-paid Command (one guaranteed conversion without a Surge, limited by failed Hit dice).

options.name: Hold Formation
options.effect: When a friendly Unit within Short is successfully Charged, that Unit gains Brace 2 against that Charge and Tough 1 against the charging Unit until the end of the Round.

options.name: Advance Orders
options.effect: Choose one unengaged friendly Unit within Short. It may immediately Move up to 3", ending legally; the Move does not grant another activation or Charge.

options.name: Fire Discipline
options.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within Short. Its next ranged or Spell Attack this Round gains EITHER Pinpoint and Accurate 1 OR Accurate 2. Pinpoint prevents shooting-into-Engagement Hit penalty and friendly-fire Direct Damage from Blunders.

options.name: Identify Threat
options.effect: Choose one visible enemy Unit within Medium and a Creature or material Trait tag it actually possesses (such as Mortal, Undead, Beast, Spirit, Infernal, Construct, Mechanical, or Armored). One friendly Unit within Short gains Anti-[that tag] 3 on its next Attack against that enemy this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never stack; use the highest.

options.name: Standard Commands
options.effect: Know two eligible Captain Command Abilities.

options.name: Additional Command
options.effect: Learn one additional eligible Command Ability. Does not provide additional CP or Doctrine cards.

notes: Captains may substitute eligible faction-specific Command Abilities for generic ones, subject to the faction's rules.

units.battlefieldRole: Competent individual combatant, battlefield leadership, and tactical flexibility.
designNotes: v4 balance pass (post-playtesting): Damage-1 weapons gained +1 Attack; the Damage-2 Great Weapon kept its listed Attacks and gained Anti-Armored 2.

v4.1 refinement: the Captain is a single Model, so Veteran (+50) stays a flat cost rather than the higher per-unit pricing used on larger multi-Model formations like Line/Ranged Infantry. Master Hunter (+25, counts as a Combat Training pick) lets the Captain choose any Faction/Unit Type/Trait tag and gain Anti-[chosen tag] 2 on all of its weapons, replacing the former narrower Monster Hunter upgrade.
The Captain is an Elite Unit (E) and not a Hero by default; Heroic Commission makes it a Hero and adds H eligibility while it keeps Elite.

rangedWeaponPackages.note: Choose up to one ranged weapon. Shield use is prohibited with Bow, Crossbow or Musket, but Pistols are one-handed and allowed.

options.name: Bow
options.effect: Adds a ranged weapon.
